title: mtf.native data
description: An engine's own MTF of a case: per requested field, the modulus at each of the F requested frequencies along image x (sagittal) and along image y (tangential), with how the engine came by it. Code checks that every curve has one length, that a field with curves holds values from 0 to 1, that a field without them holds NaN and says why, and that a plane called design is not shifted.

fields.description: One entry per requested field, in the order of the request.

field.description: The field as it was requested: a fraction of the image height, or an angle in degrees.

fieldAngleDeg.description: The chief-ray field angle the engine used, in degrees; null where it found none.

imageHeightMm.description: The distance from the axis at which the field's reference chief ray lands on the plane the MTF is of; null where there is none.

sagittal.description: MTF for frequency along image x; shape [F]. NaN in a field that is unavailable.

tangential.description: MTF for frequency along image y; shape [F]. NaN in a field that is unavailable.

status.description: ok: the engine stands by the curves. unconverged: it has curves and says its sampling did not settle. unavailable: it has none.

reason.description: The engine's own code for why the field is as its status says; always there for an unavailable field.

sampling.description: How the engine sampled the field, by names of its own: a grid size, counts of rays.

method.description: The engine's own name for how it computed the curves, and the settings it computed them with.

focus.description: The plane the curves are of.

mode.description: design for the image plane of the case as it is; else the engine's own name for the criterion that moved it.

appliedShiftMm.description: How far along +z the plane lies from the image plane of the case, mm.

aperture.description: What the engine measured of the aperture it computed with, by names of its own: recorded, never judged.

lines.description: The lines the engine actually computed with, the reference line first.

notes.description: What the engine says about the answer, for people.
